items.t: Gerdau (BOVESPA:GGBR4) Stock Draws Fresh Price Target Split As Fair Value Gets A Bump
items.sum: Gerdau is back in focus after recent research lifted bullish price targets into a range of US$5.80 to US$6.50, while more cautious views held closer to R$28. These changes reflect a split analyst narrative, with one side emphasizing execution across markets and the other highlighting trade policy and steel overcapacity risks. As the story develops, you will see how to track these shifting targets
